name: Kem bo sau rieng
summary: Kem bơ sầu riêng is a cold cup of fresh avocado and ripe durian, rich, gently sweet, and fragrant with durian.
origin: Vung Tau, on Nguyễn Du and Ba Cu.
taste: The avocado makes it rich, the ripe durian makes it fragrant, and the cup is only gently sweet.
howToEat: Eat it cold, from the cup, on a hot day.
seoTitle: Kem bo sau rieng — avocado and durian ice cream in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Avocado and durian ice cream on Nguyễn Du and Ba Cu: a cold cup, rich, gently sweet, and fragrant with durian.
